papers.title: Tailoring the texture of IN738LC processed by selective laser melting (SLM) by specific scanning strategies
papers.first_author_affiliation: General Electric (Switzerland) GmbH – GE Power, CH-5401 Baden, Switzerland

corresponding_authors.name: Karsten Kunze
corresponding_authors.affiliation: ETH Zurich, Scientific Center of Optical and Electron Microscopy (ScopeM), CH-8093 Zürich, Switzerland

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究与生物医学植入物或骨整合无关，而是专注于高温合金的织构控制。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not address biomedical implants, porous structures, stress shielding, mechanical testing for osseointegration, fatigue, or surface roughness relevant to biomedical applications.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究选择性激光熔化工艺参数对IN738LC合金织构的影响。
summary_zh.method: 通过改变扫描策略来调控晶粒取向和织构。
summary_zh.result: 成功实现了织构的定向控制。
summary_zh.validation: 通过电子背散射衍射（EBSD）和织构分析验证。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the influence of SLM scanning strategies on crystallographic texture of IN738LC superalloy.
summary_en.method: Different scanning strategies were applied to control grain orientation and texture evolution.
summary_en.result: Controlled texture was achieved with specific scanning patterns.
summary_en.validation: Validated by EBSD and texture analysis.

papers.title: The effect of stress ratio on the fatigue behavior of additively manufactured porous biomaterials
papers.abstract: Meta-biomaterials are porous biomaterials created by additive manufacturing techniques such as Selective Laser Melting. These materials are built up form a repeating unit cell, resulting in a porous structure that can be applied for bone implants or prosthetics. The mechanical properties of these meta-biomaterials can be tailored by variations in unit cell type and strut thickness, resulting in different porosity values. This makes it possible to create a material with mechanical properties similar to bone, which prevents negative side effects of conventional bone implants such as stress shielding. The fatigue behavior of these meta-biomaterials has been studied before, but only at a single stress ratio of R=0.1 This study investigates the fatigue behavior at different stress ratios which result in an increased mean stress. A cylindrical porous structure that is built up from a diamond unit cell is tested at stress ratios of R=0.1, R=0.3, R=0.5, R=0.7 and R=0.8. Two samples types are made of Ti-6Al-4V ELI powder, resulting in a theoretical porosity of 80% and 10%. Also an experimental DIC method is developed, to visualize the deformation behavior during the fatigue tests.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文直接研究多孔生物材料的疲劳行为与应力比的关系，与用户关注的多孔结构应力屏蔽和疲劳性能高度相关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not report surface roughness, as-built morphology, or osseointegration data.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究不同应力比下多孔生物材料的疲劳行为，以匹配骨力学性能并避免应力遮挡。
summary_zh.method: 通过SLM制造金刚石晶胞多孔钛合金试样，在不同应力比下进行疲劳实验并采用DIC观测变形。
summary_zh.result: 应力比增大（平均应力增加）会显著降低疲劳寿命。
summary_zh.validation: 疲劳实验结合数字图像相关（DIC）方法验证变形行为。

summary_en.motivation: This study investigates the fatigue behavior of additively manufactured porous biomaterials under various stress ratios to better understand failure under mean stress conditions for bone implant applications.
summary_en.method: Cylindrical diamond unit cell structures were fabricated from Ti-6Al-4V ELI by selective laser melting and tested at stress ratios R=0.1 to 0.8, with digital image correlation (DIC) used to visualize deformation.
summary_en.result: Increasing stress ratio (i.e., higher mean stress) leads to reduced fatigue life, demonstrating the sensitivity of porous biomaterials to mean stress.
summary_en.validation: Experimental fatigue testing with DIC provided in situ deformation data, validating the mechanical response under different loading conditions.
